title.pt: O Roubo na Balsa de Niterói

intro.en: During a midnight crossing to Niterói, a priceless maritime painting was swapped for a crude replica in the cargo hold. The theft occurred during a sudden power outage.
intro.pt: Durante uma travessia à meia-noite para Niterói, uma pintura marítima inestimável foi trocada por uma réplica mal feita no porão de carga. O roubo ocorreu durante uma queda repentina de energia.

suspects.name: Arthur Mendes

alibi.en: He was in the lounge drinking tea.
alibi.pt: Ele estava no salão bebendo chá.

suspects.facts: You were in the lounge at 23:45. You lie that you never left your seat.

suspects.name: Beatriz Silva

alibi.en: She was checking the engine room.
alibi.pt: Ela estava verificando a sala de máquinas.

suspects.facts: You were in the engine room at 23:50. You lie that the lights went out naturally.

suspects.name: Carlos Drago
suspects.facts: You were in the cargo hold at 23:55. You lie that you were guarding the painting.

suspects.name: Diana Prince

alibi.en: She was studying in her cabin.
alibi.pt: Ela estava estudando em sua cabine.

suspects.facts: You were in the corridor at 23:50. You lie that you didn't see anyone near the cargo hold.

event.pt: Passageiros se reúnem para a travessia.

event.en: The lights flicker for a moment.
event.pt: As luzes piscam por um momento.

event.en: The painting is swapped during the blackout.
event.pt: A pintura é trocada durante o apagão.

clues.ask: Where were you when the lights went out?

text.en: I was in the lounge. I saw Beatriz walking towards the engine room just before the darkness.
text.pt: Eu estava no salão. Eu vi a Beatriz caminhando em direção à sala de máquinas logo antes do escuro.

clues.ask: Did you notice anything suspicious in the engine room?

text.en: Everything was normal until the blackout. I didn't see Arthur leave the lounge area.
text.pt: Tudo estava normal até o apagão. Eu não vi o Arthur sair da área do salão.

clues.ask: Did you see anyone near the cargo hold?

text.en: I saw Carlos sneaking out of the cargo hold with a large, flat package just as the lights came back on.
text.pt: Eu vi o Carlos saindo de fininho do porão de carga com um pacote grande e plano assim que as luzes voltaram.

clues.ask: What were you doing during the blackout?

text.en: I was on the deck. I saw Diana in the corridor, she wasn't in her cabin like she claimed.
text.pt: Eu estava no convés. Eu vi a Diana no corredor, ela não estava na cabine como alegou.

clues.ask: Who had access to the cargo hold?

text.en: Only the security guard has the key to the cargo hold, and Carlos was the only one on duty.
text.pt: Apenas o segurança tem a chave do porão de carga, e o Carlos era o único de plantão.

text.en: Check the alibis. Some people are contradicting what others saw.
text.pt: Verifique os álibis. Algumas pessoas estão contradizendo o que outros viram.

text.en: The security guard is the only one who could have accessed the painting easily.
text.pt: O segurança é o único que poderia ter acessado a pintura facilmente.

solution.en: Carlos Drago used his security access to enter the cargo hold. He orchestrated a temporary short circuit in the engine room (which Beatriz noticed) to create a blackout. During the darkness, he swapped the original painting for a copy he had hidden. Diana saw him fleeing with the package, and Beatriz confirmed only he had the key.
solution.pt: Carlos Drago usou seu acesso de segurança para entrar no porão de carga. Ele orquestrou um curto-circuito temporário na sala de máquinas (que Beatriz notou) para criar um apagão. Durante a escuridão, ele trocou a pintura original por uma cópia que havia escondido. Diana o viu fugindo com o pacote, e Beatriz confirmou que apenas ele tinha a chave.

en.headline: Collector Exonerated
en.body: Arthur Mendes was wrongly accused of the theft, but evidence shows he never left his tea.

pt.headline: Colecionador Exonerado
pt.body: Arthur Mendes foi acusado injustamente do roubo, mas as evidências mostram que ele nunca deixou seu chá.

en.headline: Crew Member Mistakenly Blamed
en.body: Beatriz Silva was investigated for the blackout, but was innocent all along.

pt.headline: Tripulante Injustamente Culpada
pt.body: Beatriz Silva foi investigada pelo apagão, mas era inocente o tempo todo.

en.headline: Historian's Reputation Ruined
en.body: Diana Prince was accused of being a lookout, but the real thief has already escaped.

pt.headline: Reputação da Historiadora Arruinada
pt.body: Diana Prince foi acusada de ser cúmplice, mas o verdadeiro ladrão já escapou.

generated.seed: A ferry to Niteroi: a painting in the cargo hold is replaced by a copy
